configurations.name: db
runtimeArgs: D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cruuze-dev-pg"; if [ ! -f "$D/postgresql.conf" ]; then rm -rf "$D"; initdb -D "$D" -U cruuze --auth=trust >/dev/null; fi; exec postgres -D "$D" -p 5434 -k "$D"

configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATABASE_URL='postgres://cruuze@localhost:5434/postgres?sslmode=disable' LISTEN_ADDR=:8082 APP_URL=http://localhost:5175 SMTP_HOST= WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_DELAY=20s METRICS_TOKEN=dev INSTANCE_ADMINS=ada@example.com exec go run ./cmd/cruuze

configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: API_URL=http://localhost:8082 exec npm --prefix web run dev -- --port 5175 --strictPort

configurations.name: e2e
runtimeArgs: createdb -h localhost -p 5434 -U cruuze cruuze_e2e 2>/dev/null; cd web && PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.18.0/bin:$PATH" E2E_DATABASE_URL='postgres://cruuze@localhost:5434/cruuze_e2e?sslmode=disable' npx playwright test --reporter=list; echo "e2e-finished exit=$?"; exec sleep 900

configurations.name: gotest
runtimeArgs: (mkdir -p "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gotest-empty" && cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gotest-empty" && exec python3 -m http.server 8098 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1) & createdb -h localhost -p 5434 -U cruuze cruuze_test 2>/dev/null; cd server && TEST_DATABASE_URL='postgres://cruuze@localhost:5434/cruuze_test?sslmode=disable' go test -count=1 ./... 2>&1 | grep -v 'no test files'; echo "gotest-finished exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wait

configurations.name: built
runtimeArgs: DATABASE_URL='postgres://cruuze@localhost:5434/postgres?sslmode=disable' SMTP_HOST= APP_URL=http://localhost:8090 PORT=8090 LOG_FORMAT=json METRICS_TOKEN=dev exec server/bin/cruuze

configurations.name: seed
runtimeArgs: cd server && DATABASE_URL='postgres://cruuze@localhost:5434/postgres?sslmode=disable' go run ./cmd/seed -workspace acme-inc -team ENG -issues 50000 -days 85; echo seed-finished; exec sleep 900

configurations.name: cloudflare
runtimeArgs: cd deploy/cloudflare && PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.18.0/bin:$PATH" WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false exec npx wrangler dev --port 8791 --test-scheduled
